messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is an overview of **long‑weekend** occasions that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” here means that a statutory holiday fell on either a *Friday* or a *Monday*, thereby extending the normal Saturday‑Sunday break to three working days (or more if the holiday is observed on a different weekday).

| Date(s) | Holiday | Province / Territory | Notes |
|---------|--------|----------------------|-------|
| **January 1 (Observed Jan 2)** | New Year’s Day | All jurisdictions | When New Year’s Day lands on a weekend, the following Monday becomes the official observance. Thus 1 st (Sun) + 2 nd (Mon) created a short “new‑year” long weekend. |
| **February 20** | Family Day | Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick | Falls on a Monday → standard long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |
| **April 7** | Good Friday | All jurisdictions | Friday holiday → long weekend (Thu‑Fri‑Sat‑Sun). |
| **April 10** | Easter Monday | Ontario, Quebec, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador, Northwest Territories, Nunavut | Monday holiday → long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). *(Note: Only certain provinces observe Easter Monday.)* |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | All jurisdictions | Monday holiday → long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |
| **July 1** | Canada Day | All jurisdictions | Fell on a Saturday; no extra week‑end extension beyond the usual weekend. |
| **August 14** | Civic Holiday | Most provinces (except Ontario & Québec) | Monday holiday → long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |
| **September 4** | Labour Day | All jurisdictions | Monday holiday → long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving | All jurisdictions | Monday holiday → long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |
| **December 25** | Christmas Day | All jurisdictions | Monday holiday → long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |

### Quick Reference Summary

| Month | Long Weekend Dates | Key Holidays |
|-------|--------------------|--------------|
| Jan   | Jan 1–2            | New Year’s Day (observed) |
| Feb   | Feb 18–20          | Family Day (many provinces) |
| Apr   | Apr 5–8 (incl. Good Friday) | Good Friday |
|       | Apr 10             | Easter Monday (some provinces) |
| May   | May 20–22          | Victoria Day |
| Aug   | Aug 12–14          | Civic Holiday (most provinces) |
| Sept  | Sept 2–4           | Labour Day |
| Oct   | Oct 7–9            | Thanksgiving |
| Dec   | Dec 23–25          | Christmas Day |

> **Tip:** If your application needs province‑specific details (e.g., whether Easter Monday applies in Ontario vs. Alberta), you’ll want to cross‑reference the above table against the individual provincial holiday calendars.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the same breakdown for another year or additional regional nuances!
